notes.title: DLC: Fairytale expansion
notes.content:
Experience new adventures in the world of Gedaria with two new playable characters. You will now take control of mother from Vladimír. Malicious soldiers stole her beloved geese. Emil, the first saved goose, will become mother's inseparable companion, who will help her solve puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41274973/df8bdcbcb521811942d8f604cac3c84c98bd1fde.png[/img]

New features:
[list]
[*] control of the goose Emil
[*] Search for geese that follow Emil and Mom
[*] Emil, unlike Vladimir or mother, can swim
[*] Option to get the Golden Goose in the base game. The Golden Goose credits the acorns for defeating the enemy
[*] New Unlockable Achievements
[/list]
